  "pros": [
    "Securely stores and shares team passwords and sensitive information.",
    "Easy-to-use autofill and password generation features save significant time.",
    "Cost-effective solution, especially for small businesses."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup for team sharing and collections can be less intuitive.",
    "The free organization tier is too restrictive for a small team larger than two users.",
    "Occasional browser extension performance issues or relogin prompts can be disruptive."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Operations Assistant likely found Bitwarden to be a highly valuable tool for securely managing and sharing passwords within their small business. The autofill and password generation features significantly improved efficiency, and the overall security posture of the company. While the free tier's limitations for team use and some aspects of the initial setup for shared collections posed minor frustrations, the product's affordability and core functionality made it a strong asset for their role."
